prompts.emerald: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a PRODUCTION TRANSPARENT sprite atlas from the indicated skin in the reference board. Same polished chunky 2D painted style, upper-left lighting, deep clean edges, readable at about 80px. Strict equal THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, six completely separated assets, generous transparent cell margins; no text, grid, scenery or ground shadow. TOP LEFT: ONLY the detached round plant HEAD with its crown/accessories, eyes and long hollow tubular muzzle facing RIGHT, absolutely NO stem or feet. TOP MIDDLE: ONLY matching short STEM and TWO rooted LEAF FEET, absolutely NO head, no face, no mouth; flat rooted baseline. Head and stem are animation parts of ONE character, same front three-quarter camera. TOP RIGHT: horizontal projectile flying RIGHT with trail LEFT. BOTTOM LEFT: muzzle flash. BOTTOM MIDDLE: impact. BOTTOM RIGHT: defeat burst. Preserve recognizable plant identity, no human limbs, no weapons held in hands. Each asset entirely within its own cell, no joining lines. Background must be truly transparent alpha=0 everywhere between objects and in hollow effects, NO haze or colored backdrop. Minimal contained glow, no full-screen bloom. FIRST EMERALD skin: bright emerald green head, thin GOLD mouth rim, three-leaf gold-edged crown on head. Base: rooted emerald leaves with thin gold edges, slender green stem and amber seed jewel at top. Projectile: solid green pea with cream-gold highlight, TWO twisting emerald-gold ribbons trailing LEFT. Muzzle: small gold ring and three gold-green leaf sparks. Impact: gold-white four-petal star surrounded by broken emerald arcs. Defeat: hollow golden laurel crown burst.

emerald_background_edit: Background extraction edit only. Preserve EXACTLY these six emerald plant sprites, their 3x2 layout, gold leaf crown, green head, separate rooted stem and leaves, green-gold projectile, muzzle, impact and laurel. Remove ALL backdrop gradients, colored haze, rectangular ghost patches and stray semi-transparent noise outside the six solid sprites. Empty areas must be alpha=0, especially above and left of the head, and between head and base. Clean opaque antialiased sprite edges; no glow outside outlines except very small effect highlights. Do not change character shapes, sprite positions, or colors. Real transparent PNG cutout, no painted checkerboard.
